scope: Proposition 10.3 (Fixed-N annular gap and cap estimate) of the manuscript “Cap-selected amplitudes and triangle chords for honeycomb walks” (preprints/Cap-selected-amplitudes-and-triangle-chords-for-honeycomb-walks-September-26-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 237 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 7fd6eb0adc06ad82), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF pages 60-61. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. The quote crosses a page break and includes whatever the extraction places there, such as a page number. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. statement: Fix N ≥ N0. There is εN > 0 with the following properties. For every p0 = (0, u0, eiθ0 ), l ≤ u0 ≤ l + εN , 0 ≤ θ0 ≤ π/2, the matrix MN (p0) has a simple dominant eigenvalue λ(p0) > 0, and ρ AN (p0)  < λ(p0). The right cap Ψ at twist i and the left cap Λ at twist −i are holomorphic in the sites near 0. At homogeneous sites they are limits of rows from vacuum-empty ends at their respective twists, with reversal and spin negation on the upper end as in the definition of Λ. 60 There is a complex neighborhood U of p0, positive constants C, γ, β, and holomorphic functions λ, cphys on U, with γ < β < inf p∈U |λ(p)|, such that, for p = (b, u, K) ∈ U and all h ≥ 0, |E− h (p)| + |E+ h (p)| + |Ch(p)| ≤ Cγh , |Gh(p) − cphys(p)λ(p)h | ≤ Cβh . (10.3) Here λ(p) continues the stated annular eigenvalue. At K = i in a vacuum neighborhood, λ = 1 and cphys = 1. The gaps, constants and neighborhoods in this proposition may depend on N.
